args.text:
Batch: 8 runs, 8 accepted, 0 flagged, 8 cleared (r01 to r08).
All three kinematic checks passed on every run: rigid-body invariance, closure and plane sections. No remedies were kept, no roll backs were made and the width-free ratio was not used.
r07's centre strain-rate peak (111.61 %/h) and largest flank difference (-13.49 %/h) are about 2.1 times the batch values. Its peak position (421 µm) and growth-zone length (684 µm) match the batch, and its stride is 1, so this reads as a faster-growing root, not a time-base fault.
The other large |z| values (r01 to r03 growth zone, r05/r08 peak and flank position) come from a batch MAD near zero. They stand for differences of only about 11 µm or 0.04 %/h.
No runs were flagged, so the flagged runs have nothing in common to report.
